name: Greedy Meshing / Face Culling
definition: An algorithm to generate geometry for a chunk by iterating through its blocks, checking for exposed faces (neighbors missing), and generating triangles only for those exposed faces.
summary: Greedy Meshing / Face Culling generates a static triangle mesh by emitting geometry only for faces adjacent to empty space, differing from standard Greedy Meshing by not merging coplanar faces into larger quads.
